notes.title: CriminalZ 0.3 Closed Beta is LIVE!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey CriminalZ Crew,[/b][/p][p]Big news! The long-anticipated [b]Version 0.3[/b] is now officially available as a [b]Closed Beta[/b] on Steam!
This update marks a huge milestone in development and lays the groundwork for the full experience CriminalZ aims to become.
[/p][p]🛠️ [b]What’s new in 0.3?[/b][/p][list][*][p]A complete gameplay overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]New loot systems with smarter item drops[/p][/*][*][p]First version of Heists (mini-dungeons with time pressure and big rewards!)[/p][/*][*][p]More immersive city environment[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI and player feedback systems[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of bug fixes and performance improvements
[/p][/*][/list][p]🎟️ [b]Want access?[/b]
All you need to do is [b]join our Discord[/b] and request a [b]Beta Key[/b]!
👉 [url="https://discord.gg/Xjun9ygV6h"]https://discord.gg/Xjun9ygV6h[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We’re opening this version only to selected players for now to keep things focused and gather meaningful feedback. Once it's more stable, we’ll move toward the [b]Open Alpha[/b] stage.
[/p][p]👀 [b]This version includes[/b] one demo city and a first playable heist.
The goal: [b]Loot, survive, strategize[/b] – and help us improve the experience before launch.[/p][p]Thank you for supporting this indie project – your feedback will help shape the future of CriminalZ.[/p][p]See you in the streets.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/85741c99aafb529f3e149cdabe47e75329bb9e59.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/ac6f94fcf029dd49a617d9ce0efd74f1a60f7418.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/b5fd96d78a93d51dd758e0a883acdf1180479bf5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/3320ab1694f9ce6d776179bf68ccb2c9fd2f891e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/f7472899b0b7bacc30617da5abbc21953d8b2bee.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/271391ea05b1dc24d9158e0acb6e5fc844640790.png"][/img]

— The CriminalZ Dev[/p]

notes.title: 🧨 Update 0.3 – More Immersion, New Raids & the First Interrior!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I’ve been working hard on preparing [b]Update 0.3[/b], and I’m really excited to share what’s coming next for [i]CriminalZ[/i]. This update focuses heavily on [b]immersion[/b] and introduces the [b]very first playable interrior[/b].
[/p][h3]🔊 A More Immersive Experience[/h3][p]To enhance the feel of the world, I’ve been improving the overall [b]player experience[/b] — especially during looting. Looting is now more satisfying, thanks to new [b]sound effects[/b] and [b]UI feedback[/b]. Each item pickup should feel impactful, and it’s now clearer what kind of loot you've found.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/e4b3f7d7d49f895d707a84a1b73070078ad8ef65.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/b524004a16456df47b0669fc574371909c3c7249.png"][/img][/p][h3]
👊 Boss Interface Overhaul[/h3][p]The [b]boss UI[/b] has also been redesigned. Before each new stage, players will now receive a [b]short message at the top of the screen[/b] telling them what’s changed in the current wave. Every stage is now more challenging — but also [b]more rewarding[/b].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/8b2c2f8d3a5e88d38885fd815a293dc5afbad84b.png"][/img][/p][h3]
🌌 Raid Portals Reworked[/h3][p]I’ve completely changed the [b]portal visuals and sounds[/b]. Entering a raid should now feel more like [b]"We’re about to hit this place hard!"[/b]
Portals can now spawn in [b]different rarities[/b] — and the rarer the portal, the [b]better the loot[/b] you’ll find inside. Get ready to hunt for those high-tier raids!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/e2047acdb602aaa1d2545672d214ef54d2d6cdd7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/3aa7f4c6b96be79120f6c4cb4fa909b3c8745f09.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/a6b2a71a454bd324143481486a8ff735687f75ca.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]If you’ve got [b]questions[/b], want to [b]share your ideas[/b], or just hang out with other players, be sure to [b]join our Discord[/b].

[url="https://discord.gg/fh6vPGekTd"]https://discord.gg/fh6vPGekTd[/url]

I’d love to hear your feedback — it helps me shape the future of the game![/p][p]Thanks for all your support. –
CriminalZ Dev[/p]

notes.title: CriminalZ is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I’m super excited to finally share that [b]CriminalZ[/b] is officially available on [b]Steam[/b].  [/p][p]It’s getting real — the dream of releasing an original co-op game about crime and chaos is now public.   [b]What’s CriminalZ?[/b]  [/p][p]A co-op rogue lite criminal game inspired by the vibes of [b]Lethal Company[/b] — gather loot, survive interior raids, and grow your criminal empire. And of course... be criminal to get as much money as possible! Money will be needed to fulfill the quota for the boss, otherwise you loose the game! [/p][p][b]Wishlist CriminalZ now[/b] [/p][p]Every wishlist helps boost visibility on Steam, so even if you’re just curious, [b]your click makes a difference[/b].  [b]Ongoing development[/b][/p][p]This is just the beginning. Community feedback is at the core of this journey. Let me know what YOU want to see!   

[b]Click here to wishlist now!
[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3799570/CriminalZ/"][/dynamiclink][b]


[/b]Fore More join our Discord:  [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/XetMhkREeK"]https://discord.gg/XetMhkREeK[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Thanks for supporting this dream.  [/p][p][b]Let’s build something big. Together. [/b][/p][p]— The Dev[/p]
